title: Croatian Shrimp Pasta
description: A cultured and juicy Croatian dish featuring shrimp, canola oil, and Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and just cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set them aside.
Add the white wine and chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until it is al dente.
Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet with the wine and broth mixture.
Toss the pasta in the skillet to combine with the sauce.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
